parse.title: Guardians of the Rift
parse.wikitext:
==Rewards== At the end of a game, players will receive points and Runecraft experience equal to their Runecraft level × 45 as long as they gained at least 300 total energy during the game. An elemental point will be given for every 100 elemental energy and a catalytic point will be given for every 100 catalytic energy, with a chance of rounding up (e.g. 73 elemental energy will give a 73% chance of gaining one elemental point). One of each are used to search the [[Rewards Guardian]], located just outside the rift gate, where players can receive their rewards. A maximum of 1,200 total energy can be earned per game (1,320 when using the abyssal lantern burning yew logs), with a cap of 1,000 per energy type. If a player reaches the maximum point cap, the chatbox will display the message {{mes|You are fully attuned with runic energy and cannot earn anymore until the rift has been closed.}} ===Rewards Guardian=== {{Main|Rewards Guardian}} [[File:Rewards Guardian.png|thumb|right|The Rewards Guardian.]] Rewards from the Guardian include a standard loot table including runes and talismans, as well as various unique rewards. {| class="wikitable lighttable align-center-1" style=width:700px; ! colspan="2" | Item ! Also has a chance at granting a [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard clue]]. |- | {{plinkt|Atlax's diary}} | An old diary of someone's experiences at the Temple of the Eye. |- | {{plinkt|Elemental talisman}} | Grants access to all elemental [[runic altar]]s. |- | {{plinkt|Catalytic talisman}} | Grants access to all catalytic runic altars, provided the player has completed the quests to access those that require it. |- | {{plinkt|Abyssal needle}} | Combines all [[essence pouch]]es into one [[colossal pouch]] ({{SCP|Crafting|56|link=yes}} required).
